items.title: Side expands presence in China, opens new studio and acquires art outsourcing provider Roboto Entertainment
items.en_title: Side expands presence in China, opens new studio and acquires art outsourcing provider Roboto Entertainment

items.title: 触乐怪话：修好了一台PS5
items.en_title: ChuApp Odd Talk: Fixing a PS5
items.en_oneliner: A ChuApp writer recounts getting an overheating, auto-shutting-down PS5 repaired, going from the official service center to third-party repairers on Xianyu before finally bringing the console back to life.

items.title: "It was a pretty harrowing three months" – Undead Labs head Philip Holt on what happened after Xbox cut the studio loose
items.en_title: "It was a pretty harrowing three months" – Undead Labs head Philip Holt on what happened after Xbox cut the studio loose
items.en_oneliner: The studio head recalled in an interview the harrowing three months after Xbox cut the studio loose, describing how the team found a way forward amid upheaval, worth founders' reading.

items.title: Netflix reportedly offered $500m to Microsoft to license Xbox IP for seven years
items.en_title: Netflix reportedly offered $500m to Microsoft to license Xbox IP for seven years
items.en_oneliner: Netflix reportedly offered $500 million for seven years of Xbox IP film and TV adaptation rights, with game IP cross-media value continuing to rise.

items.title: Build your own world in ‘Fangtopia’
items.en_oneliner: The relaxed, eerie puzzle game Fangtopia lets players build a world for monsters with hex tiles, and its small-scale building gameplay is well worth borrowing for indie developers.
